summary: Feed s054_single is degraded: NDR 10 Gbps port is overloaded by microbursts peaking at 12.51 Gbps (125% of capacity, 3 intervals >80% threshold), causing ingress drops and reduced detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding aggregated/bursty traffic to a single 10 Gbps NDR port without load balancing. Peak 1ms burst measured 12.51 Gbps (125% of port capacity, threshold 80% = 8 Gbps) across 3 overloaded intervals, indicating sustained microburst overload, not a transient spike.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will drop excess packets at ingress during bursts. As NDR needs both directions and full payload, drops break TCP reassembly, flow correlation and payload inspection, causing missed detections, incomplete session metadata and blind spots for threats.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2+ 10G NDR ports with 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and preserve flow coherence, eliminating burst drops while maintaining both directions per flow to the same tool instance.
